description: Looks for a payment tagged with a request’s reference (nimbooks:invoice:<id>) in the address’s transactions — the same match the NimBooks app uses to mark a request paid. Read-only: it reports what the chain says and changes nothing, here or in the app. Scans the newest 200 transactions.

address.description: The payee address the request was made for. Optional; defaults to the server’s configured address.

id.description: The request id, as returned by create_payment_request.

name: check_request_paid
title: Check whether a request was paid
